This '''villa''' was the house of [[Lik Ankkit]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] that oversaw the production of [[barq]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. It was commandeered by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Ghez Hokan]] as his base of operations to protect the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Qiilura nanovirus research facility|research facility]] headed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]].<ref name="hc">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
